Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Neena Bansal Krishna
 Order
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. Petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as B.N.S.S.
)/482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, has been filed on behalf of the Petitioners for quashing of the FIR No. 61/2025 under Section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Hauz Qazi.

4. On filing of PF/RC by the Petitioners, Notice of the Petition be issued to the Complainant,
through Investigating Officer including ordinary post and electronic mode, returnable on 02.05.2025.
5.
On advance Notice, Mr. Shoaib Haider, learned APP for the State has appeared and seeks time to file a Status Report.

6. Let the Status Report be filed within three weeks with copy to the opposite counsel.
7.
This is a digitally signed order.
